title: This is a nice personal fan UPDATE: turns on and off for no reason.
text:
This is a nice personal fan UPDATE: turns on and off for no reason.. Update: I loved this fan so much, I ordered another one. Now, I'm so disappointed after using the first fan for about 8 nights (changed batteries), it started going on and off by itself. For no reason I can find, it just shuts down, then turns back on. I was afraid of fire so I turned it off. I hope the second one doesn't start doing this or I will have to change it to 1 star.

This is a nice personal fan. I plugged it into my little macbook air. It's a lot stronger than I thought it would be especially for it's size. It's not very big so would be very easy to pack into a small bag. I recommend getting a usb adapter for it in case you don't have a usb port to plug it into.

The springs for the batteries are very thin. It's awkward to get the batteries into the bottom because you have to get them under the upper battery springs. I don't see this as being very durable, therefore, I have to reduce from 5 stars to 4.
